Package org.apache.juneau.commons.utils

Class JsonValueSafety

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.JsonValueSafety
public final class JsonValueSafety extends Object
Bounded, iterative walker that validates already-materialized JSON values against structural safety limits.

This helper defends against pathological inputs (excessive nesting, unbounded node counts, cyclic references, and runaway traversal times) before a value is serialized or otherwise consumed. It walks only in-memory maps, collections, arrays, and scalar leaves; it never resolves "$ref" or performs any I/O.

All violations are reported as neutral IllegalArgumentExceptions. Typed or adaptor callers are responsible for mapping these to the appropriate JSON-RPC error code, which keeps this core class free of any revision-specific error policy.

    • check

      public static void check(Object value, String label)
      Validates the specified value against the structural safety limits using a fresh deadline.
      Parameters:
      value - The value to walk. Can be null, in which case this method returns immediately.
      label - A human-readable label describing the value; used as a prefix in violation messages.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the value violates any of the depth, node-count, traversal-time, or JSON-shape constraints.

    • check

      public static void check(Object root, String label, long deadlineNanos)
      Validates the specified value against the structural safety limits using the specified traversal deadline.
      Parameters:
      root - The value to walk. Can be null, in which case this method returns immediately.
      label - A human-readable label describing the value; used as a prefix in violation messages.
      deadlineNanos - An absolute deadline in System.nanoTime() units after which the traversal is aborted.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the value exceeds MAX_DEPTH, exceeds MAX_NODES, exceeds the traversal deadline, contains a non-string JSON object key, or contains a leaf that is not a JSON value type (String, Number, or Boolean).

    • remainingNanos

      public static long remainingNanos(long deadlineNanos)
      Computes the number of nanoseconds remaining before the specified deadline.
      Parameters:
      deadlineNanos - An absolute deadline in System.nanoTime() units.
      Returns:
      The remaining nanoseconds, or 0 if the deadline has already passed.
